findings.title: Missing await on async fetch_rate call
findings.body: `fetch_rate` is an async function, but line 17 calls it without `await`, so the function returns a coroutine object instead of the rate. This will raise a `TypeError` when the multiplication is attempted. Add `await` before `fetch_rate(pair)`.

findings.title: Result of multiplication is rounded to int
findings.body: The function returns `int`, but multiplying `amount_cents` (an `int`) by `rate` (a `Decimal`) and rounding to `int` may lose precision and truncate fractional cents. Return a `Decimal` to preserve the exact converted amount.

summary.problem: The new async function `converted_cents` lacks an await on `fetch_rate` and returns an imprecise integer.
summary.done_well: The function signature and docstring clearly describe the conversion intent and expected output type.
